svg.title: Yang Hao — Field Notes
svg.desc: Yang Hao, software engineer building with LLMs. Works on LLM agents and developer tooling, and contributes fixes to the open-source projects they depend on: agent frameworks, developer tools and data libraries. Java, Python, Go, TypeScript.

g.text: I work on agents and developer tooling, and contribute fixes
to the open-source projects I depend on.
